name: At what point in a bathroom remodel is finish carpentry installed?

mainEntity.name: At what point in a bathroom remodel is finish carpentry installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Bathroom finish carpentry typically happens toward the end of a remodel, after drywall finishing and tile installation are completed. Installing baseboards, casings, and vanities after tile ensures clean transitions and tight scribing against tile floors or shower surrounds. Plumbing rough-ins and electrical lines must already be inspected and closed up behind drywall before cabinetry or trim goes up. However, finish painting often occurs in tandem with trim work—our crew primes and preps trim, installs it securely, and handles final caulking and paint touch-ups as a unified interior finish package.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry is installed after drywall and tile work are finished, but before final plumbing trim-out and final coat painting.
